text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Monika is confused by Medusa's unexpected statement. Unable to leave her alone to her devices, she decides to hear the details.
text_block_list.orig_text:
メドゥーサの思いがけない発言に、
困惑するモニカ。
放ってはおけずに、
詳しい話を聞くことにした。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: ...So, do you have any proof that Lady Nephy Nella did anything terrible to your family?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……それで、
ネフィ＝ネラ殿が
其方たち家族に
酷いことをした確証はあるのか？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: T-That's well, umm... I-I'm just getting started on gathering actual evidence...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは……
その。
しょ、
証拠はこれからだけど……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...My older sisters suddenly disappeared one day. And then...a lot of things happened, Nephy Nella seized my territory and all of its people. Now... I'm the only one in our mansion.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……アタシのお姉ちゃんたち、
ある日突然いなくなっちゃったの。
それで……
色々あって、
領地も領民も
ネフィ＝ネラに取り上げられて。
今は……
屋敷には
アタシ一人よ。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: There's no way those kind older sisters of mine would just up and disappear without saying anything to me. Also they're incredibly strong, so I can't just believe they lost to anyone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの優しいお姉ちゃんたちが
アタシに何も言わずにいなくなるなんてありえない。
すっごく強いから、
負けちゃったってこともないはずだけど……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: But... if they were up against THAT Nephy Nella, then maybe... she's keeping my older sisters locked up away somewhere, to steal our territory and the title of “Snake”... I'm sure that's the case. There’s no doubt about it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも……
あのネフィ＝ネラ相手だったら、
もしかしたら……
お姉ちゃんたちを
どこかに閉じ込めてるのかもしれないわ、
領土と
『蛇』の称号を奪うために……
きっとそうよ。
違いないわ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it seems that she may be imagining things trying to fill the gaps of her lacking knowledge, but there's no doubt that Medusa's sisters have disappeared and that their territory has been confiscated.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
本人の思い込みもありそうだが
メドゥーサの姉上が姿を消したこと、
領土を接収されていることは
間違いないようだな。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Whatever the case, there's not enough information to go by to make an educated decision... For her to take any kind of action like that, it's merely too reckless. All I can do right now is keep a watch over her and help searching for her sisters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにもかくにも
判断材料が足りないな……
ここで決断を下すのは早すぎる。
今は
姉上の捜索をしながら
見守るしかあるまい。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: I'm sure Medusa's pretty upset on the inside... I get annoyed at her every word, but I can't just leave her alone. I have to keep an eye on her so she doesn't do anything reckless like she did the other day...
text_block_list.orig_text:
メドゥーサのやつ、
内心かなりまいっているだろう……
いちいち言葉尻に腹は立つが、
放っておくわけにはいかんな。
また先日のような無茶をしないように
見ておかねば……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: I understand your plight. If I notice anything that might lead to your sisters, I'll let you know right away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
話は分かった。
私が気付いたことがあれば
すぐに知らせよう。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Now, let's go to the entry desk for the Snake Festival. I think that chance to meet Lady Nephy Nella isn't wrong to pursue. As for the rest...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
蛇祭りのエントリーにも行くぞ。
ネフィ＝ネラ殿に会えるチャンスは残しておいた方がいい。
あとは──

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐうぅ～……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Ah...
text_block_list.orig_text: あっ……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Heh! Ahahaha! Haha! You can't fight on an empty stomach! Before you do anything, you always need to eat! Wait there, I'll get you something from the food stall.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっ、
あははは、
はは！　
腹が減っては戦はできん！
何をするにも
まずは腹ごしらえが必要だな！
そこで待っていろ、
屋台で何か買ってきてやる。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...What's with that! Suddenly acting like an adult even though you're just a kid. However, maybe this consideration could help a little...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なによ、
お子様のくせに大人ぶっちゃって。
でも、
ちょっと助かるかも……

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Hold on a second, Miss Serpent. I'll have you know it is DANGEROUS to trust outsiders so brazenly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お待ちなさいな、
蛇のお嬢さん。
よそ者を簡単に信用するのはデンジャーでございますわ！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Uweh?! Where did you even come from so suddenly? ...I never recall meeting a suspicious bat-woman like you around before...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
誰よいきなり？
……
アンタみたいな胡散臭い蝙蝠女に
知り合いなんていないんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: NGH! WHOOOOOOOOO ARE YOU CALLING A BAT-WOMAN YOU RU-... Ahem, ahem. The name's Kanon, that is--your comrade, someone who holds a grudge against Nephy Nella, in other words, I'm just like you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ッ！　
だぁ～
れが蝙蝠ですってこのチっ……
ヲホン、
ヲホン。
あたくしはカノン、
アナタのお同志──
すなわち、
アナタと同じくネフィ＝ネラに恨みを持つ者ですわっ！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...! You too... have a bone to pick with Nephy Nella?
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！　
アンタも
ネフィ＝ネラに……？

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Yeeees, that's exactly right. That Nephy... She's the one who made me, a gorgeous and noble being, ride a ball, pass through a ring of fire, and then... she even drew a face on my slender belly adorning this SEXY body of mine, to then make me dance before her! How cruel! THINKING BACK THAT'S JUST UNFORGIVABLE, DAMN HEEEEEEER!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇそうなんですの。
ネフィときたら……
この華麗で高貴なあたくし様に
玉乗りだの火の輪くぐりだのさせたうえ、
スレンダーかつセクシーな
おヘソ周りに顔を描いて踊らせる暴虐！　
許せねぇですわチクショーッ！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... So, like I said, you who are in the same situation as me, I'm going to u-... I mean, I'd like you to lend me your strength to defeat Nephy Nella.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぜぇ、
ぜぇ……
で、
ですからして。
同じ境遇のアナタをコキ使っ……
ではなく、
お願いいたします。
打倒ネフィ＝ネラに
お力をお貸しいただきたいですわ。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...My strength... you want it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……力を、
貸す？

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Once counted as part of the Six Calamities, the "Gorgon Sisters". Of course I'd know of your name and fame. I heard that the three of you even fought on equal terms with that annoying "Fenrir".
text_block_list.orig_text:
かつて
『六凶』の一柱に数えられた
ゴルゴーン姉妹の名前くらい、
あたくし様も知らないワケじゃございませんわ。
なんとあのクソやかましい『フェンリル』とも、
互角に渡り合ったとか。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Th-That’s right! My big sisters are really, really strong! There's no way they could be defeated by someone like Nephy Nella...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっ……
そーよ！
お姉ちゃんたちは、
とってもとっても強いんだから！
ネフィ＝ネラなんかにやられるはず、
ないんだから……！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: How naive of you, Medusa-san. Nephy is a cowardly, high-quality sadist. I'm sure your sisters were sealed away using some suspicious magic tool... just like Earth Hydra.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お甘いですわねメドゥーサさん。
ネフィは
卑怯上等のおサディスト──
きっとアナタのお姉さんたちも、
あやしげな魔道具でも使って
封じられたんじゃありませんの？　
アースハイドラみたいに。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...! Th-That's right! I'm sure that's the case, however...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！
そ、
そうよ！
きっとそうだわ、
でも……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: If you're speaking the truth, then how am I supposed to save my sisters...? I don't know of any possible way to break a seal on magic tools. Nor do I know a single person who's capable of such a task.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが本当なら、
どうやってお姉ちゃんたちを助ければいいのかしら……
アタシ、
魔道具の封印の解き方なんか知らないし。
そんなことできそうな知り合いだって、
一人も──

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: ...There's someone, you know? Right in front of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──いますわよ？
ここに。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ？

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Oh ho ho♪ In my hands, such a seal is a trifle joke. Easier than twisting a pack of baby wipes. In fact, I've solved one such seal before, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヲ～
ッホッホ♪　
あたくし様の手にかかればその程度
赤子のリストをツイストするよりヌルゲーですわ。
実際、
以前チョチョイと解いて差し上げたコトもありますし？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's with that smug look on your face?! Even I could do that much! ...I-If someone were to tell me how, that is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
何よそのドヤ顔！
アタシだって、
それくらいできるもん！
……誰かに
教えてもらったら……

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Umu, umu... Well then, let's go ahead with this plan. Medusa-san, you will lend me your power as the youngest daughter of the Gorgon Sisters. It doesn't matter how much of an "Iron" Princess she is, once she turns to stone, she will be mi-... I mean, ours.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむふむ……
では、
このように致しましょう。
メドゥーサさんは、
ゴルゴーンの末娘としての力をあたくしに貸す。
いくら鉄媛といったって、
石になっちまえばコッチのもんですわ。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: After that, I will teach you how to break the seal, Medusa-san. Of course, I will also help you find your sisters' whereabouts at the same time. How about that? Isn't this what they call a "WIN-WIN" situation?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもってあたくし様は、
メドゥーサさんに
封印の解き方を教える。
もちろん
お姉さまたちの居場所捜しも
協力して差し上げますわ。
いかがかしら？　
まさしく
おWin-Winではなくって？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: What should I do? She's clearly the definition of suspicious... But I don't have any clues on where to find my sisters, and there's no one else I can rely on right now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしよう、
すごく怪しいけど……
でも、
お姉ちゃん捜しは全く手がかりがないし、
今のアタシに
頼れる人なんて
他に──

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Sorry to have kept you waiting, Medusa! There's so much delicious looking stuff around, I've bought a mountain of it! Now your stomach's sure to be filled... Hmm, are you an acquaintance of hers?
text_block_list.orig_text:
待たせたなメドゥーサ！　
美味そうなものが目白押しで
山ほど買い込んでしまったぞ！　
これで
其方の腹の虫も……
む、
そちらは
其方の知り合いか？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...Worry not about her. More importantly, is that really all you could find? I found a good food stall over there, so let's go buy something before they sell out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……何でもないわ。
それよりご飯それだけ？
あっちにいい屋台見つけたから、
売り切れる前に買いに行きましょ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: What, really?! This amount of food still isn't enough?! ...I-I see... Understood. Well then, excuse me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだと！？　
これでも足りないのか！？
……そ、
そうか……
承知した。
では、
失礼。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: M-MEDUSA-SAN, uh... Well, whatever. I still have other options lined up just in case. But if you ever need my help, that door is always open. You can count on me! I'm on your side! OOOOOOH HO HO HO HO!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
メドゥーサさ……
まあ、
いいですわ。
他にもアテはありますし？
でも
あたくしの手を借りたくなったら、
いつでも
頼ってくださいませ。
あたくしは
アナタの
味方ですわよ！　
ヲ～
ッホッホッホ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Her laugh is so loud you can hear her from a mile away... What a suspicious individual...
text_block_list.orig_text:
た、
高笑いが
ここまで聞こえてくるぞ……
どうにも怪しい手合いだな……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After parting ways with Kanon, the two of them started walking around eating at the local food stalls.
text_block_list.orig_text:
カノンと別れた後、
二人は屋台で食べ歩きをはじめた。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Ugh... This sure is spicy...! My lips are stinging...
text_block_list.orig_text:
く
うぅ……
これは辛い……！
唇がヒリヒリするぞ……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: H-Hmph, I knew it, you're still a child after all. If you're whining about something like this, you won't be able to survive in Gio Gehenna.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ、
ふん、
やっぱりお子様ね。
これくらいでヒィヒィ言ってるようじゃ、
ジオ・ゲヘナでは生きていけないわよ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: ...I mean, well, it's certainly spicy, but there's a definite umami flavor behind the spiciness. And the flavor of this spice that hits your nose! Yes, it's delicious and leaves you wanting more. Still very spicy, though!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いや、
たしかに辛いが、
辛さの奥に確かな旨味があるな。
それに
鼻にぬけるこのスパイスの風味！
うん、
後を引くうまさだ。
辛いがな！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: That's too much of a cheeky comment for a kid... W-Well, I'm sure you'll get tired of spicy food, won't you? Fortunately, there's stalls around here that hail from Landosol too, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お子様のくせに生意気なコメントね……
ま、
まあ
辛い物ばかりじゃアンタも飽きてくるんじゃない？
ランドソルからも
出店が来てるんでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: That's right. We've set up a lot of stalls that specialize in sweets in particular! The classic New Year's sweets, oshiruko, fruit candy, chocolate bananas... I'll have you know I'm also the one in charge of candy distribution!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだな。
特に
甘味の屋台を多めに設置しているぞ！
正月の定番のおしるこや、
フルーツあめやチョコバナナ…
私の権限で
駄菓子の配布もやっているのだ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: After all, sweets are my specialty. Is there anything that interests you among those options, Medusa?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにしろ甘味は
私の専門分野だからな。
メドゥーサの気になるものは
何かあるか？

text_block_list.name: メドゥーサ
text_block_list.text:
……こいつ、
結構ちゃんとしてるじゃない……
バカみたいな口げんかしたかと思えば、
冷静な行動もできるし。
子どもじゃないって
もしかして本当なの？
text_block_list.orig_text:
……こいつ、
結構ちゃんとしてるじゃない……
バカみたいな口げんかしたかと思えば、
冷静な行動もできるし。
子どもじゃないって
もしかして本当なの？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Eh, ah... I don't know much about sweets, so I'll leave it to you. You... You're familiar with them, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
あ……
アタシは甘いものって詳しくないから、
アンタに任せるわ。
アンタ、
詳しいんでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: I know everything down to the details! Let's go get some candy first. It's an assortment I carefully selected. I'm sure you'll like it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
詳しいとも！　
ならまずは
駄菓子をもらいにいくとしよう。
私が厳選した詰め合わせだ、
気に入るに違いないぞ！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: The candy distribution event will be held here! There will be lots of snacks, so please stay calm and line up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
駄菓子の配布会はこちらでーす！
たくさんありますので、
落ち着いて並んでくださーい！

text_block_list.name: Child 1
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thanks, Nii-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったー！　
ありがとな、
兄ちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: ...My comrade and... what are you two doing here? This place wasn't your responsibility, comrade...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……貴公ら、
何をしているんだ。
ここは
貴公らの受け持ちでは
なかったはず……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Oh, Monika. You see, there were more people around than we previously thought... We ended up helping out with lining up and handing out the tickets.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
モニカさん。
それが、
思ったより人が集まっちゃってね……
急遽列整理や
配布係を手伝うことになったの。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: ...Certainly, I can see that things around here are bustling. It can't be helped, we'll also help out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……確かに予想以上の賑わいだな。
仕方ない、
我々も手伝おう。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Eh? Help... Me too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
手伝うって、
アタシも？

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Umu! We're counting on you. There is an old saying in Landosol I'm very fond of: "Candies after a hard day's work taste especially good".
text_block_list.orig_text:
うむ！　
よろしく頼む。
古来、
ランドソルにはこんな格言も伝わっているぞ。
『働いた後の駄菓子は格別な美味さだ』、
とな。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: That saying... it doesn't have to be candy to make sense, does it!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それ別に
駄菓子じゃなくてもいいヤツよね！？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Here, for you. Make sure not to drop it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいこれ。
落とすんじゃないわよ。

text_block_list.name: Child 2
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks, Onee-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
ありがとう
お姉ちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: That's all for today's distribution. Thanks for your help, Medusa. You were a great help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今の子で
今日の配布分はお終いね。
手伝ってくれてありがとう、
メドゥーサ。
すごく助かったわ！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: You should be grateful. I just came here to get some candy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
恩に着てよね。
アタシはただ、
お菓子をもらいに来ただけなんだから……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is this an assortment of candy? It's a lot more than the ones you were handing out. A-Are you sure?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
これって
駄菓子の詰め合わせ？
配ってたのより
ずいぶん多いけど。
い、
いいの？

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: What are you fidgeting for? Isn't that what you came here in the first place to get? So go ahead and take it, no need to hold back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにを言っている。
元々それをもらいにきたのではないか。
遠慮なく受け取ればいい！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Then I'll take it without hesitation. I'll check out if your tastes in sweets really are worth something.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そう。
なら遠慮なくもらっとく。
アンタのセンス、
見極めてやるわ。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's with this black liquid...? Hmm, so you say this is oshiruko. It looks like a soup made from boiled beans, but... wow, it's sweet! But it's a kind of comforting sweetness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なにこの黒い液体……
ふぅん、
これがおしるこ……
見た目は
豆を煮たスープみたいだけど……
うわ、
甘っ！
……でも、
なんだかホッとする甘さだわ。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Actually, haven't you only been giving me sweets? Is that okay? Is it okay to give so many of them out? They're valuable in Gio Gehenna, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ていうか、
アンタには甘いものばっかもらってない？
大丈夫？　
こんなに配っちゃっていいの？
ジオ・ゲヘナでは貴重なものなのよ？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: It's like he's spoonfeeding her...
text_block_list.orig_text: 餌付けされてる……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Ah! Hey, Monika, what's with that stall? They sell cute animal dolls...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ねえモニカ、
あの屋台なに？
かわいい動物の人形が売ってるけど……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah, those are candy sculptures. It's the art of making animals and other things out of candy. Amazing, isn't it? Beautiful, delicate, and delicious. It's safe to say it's an art in its own right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
ああ、
あれは飴細工だな。
飴を使って
動物などを作る技術だ。
見事なものだろう？
美しくて繊細で
さらに美味いのだ。
芸術といって差し支えないな！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Candy... Eh, so you can actually eat that! I can't believe it... You can make such beautiful things out of food...
text_block_list.orig_text:
飴って……
え、
じゃああれ食べれるの！
信じられない……
食べ物からこんなキレイな物が作れるなんて……

text_block_list.name: Candymaker
text_block_list.text: Oh, young lady, is this your first time seeing creations made out of candy? I'll make you anything you like. Just ask me anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
嬢ちゃん
飴細工ははじめてかい？
好きなの、
なんでも作ってやるよ。
なんでも言ってくんな！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: The best part about candy crafts is that you can make whatever you want on the spot. Just make a request. The process of making them is also wonderful!
text_block_list.orig_text:
即興で好きな物を作ってもらえるのも
飴細工の醍醐味だ。
リクエストしてみるといい。
作る過程も素晴らしいものだぞ！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...Then, can you make a pair of snakes? I'd like to see two snakes entangled like this, looking like they're good friends. Make sure to craft them really beautifully.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……それじゃあ、
蛇、
作れる？
二匹の蛇がこう、
仲良さそうに
絡まり合ってるのがいいの。
すっごくきれいな蛇にしてね。

text_block_list.name: Candymaker
text_block_list.text: Snakes, huh. You've got style, young lady. Leave it to me. I'll do a little bit of this... Here, I'm done!
text_block_list.orig_text:
蛇か、
シブいね
嬢ちゃん。
任せときな。
こいつを
ちょちょいっとこうやって……
ほら、
いっちょ上がりだ！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Y-You've really done it as I asked... Such craftsmanship... It's so pretty... Almost like a jewel...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
本当にできた……
すっごく上手……
それにキレイ……
まるで宝石みたい……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: I'd like to eat it right away, but... I'll save this for later. This is something I want to show to my sisters too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すぐに食べたいけど……
これはまだ、
とっておくわ。
お姉ちゃんにも見せてあげたいから。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: That's a good idea. Then I guess we should buy something we can eat right away. Master, give me everything you've got lined up here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それもいいだろう。
それじゃあ
今食べる用の飴も買うとしよう。
大将、
ここに並んでいるの
全部くれ！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Monika, you... Aren't you just the best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
モニカ、
アンタ……
最高じゃない！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, Monika and her friends enjoyed the festival until the sun went down.
text_block_list.orig_text: その後モニカたちは日が暮れるまで祭りを楽しんだ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, Saren I heard you're returning to Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば、
サレンは一度
ランドソルに戻るのだったな。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm leaving Gio Gehenna and spending the whole day tomorrow at the Orphanage. It might sound obvious, but I can't leave them alone for New Year's.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
この後ジオ・ゲヘナを発って
明日一日は救護院で過ごすわ。
さすがに正月に
留守にするわけにはいかないもの。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Huh? Saren-san, are you not going to participate in the pre-party of the festival? Well, actually, we just decided on it just a second ago...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ～？
サレンさん、
前夜祭は参加しないんですか～？
って、
実は先ほど決まったばっかりですけど～

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Huh? So suddenly?! There's already a festival going on, so I wonder what you're speaking of when you say a "pre-party for the festival".
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
そんな突然！？
すでにお祭り騒ぎだけど、
前夜祭っていったい何をするのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Yes! Basically, we'll be drinking, eating, and having a blast! But there will also be some snake-related competitions, so it's going to be a lot of fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい～！　
基本飲んで食べて大騒ぎ！　
なんですけど～
蛇にまつわる勝負事なんかもあって
すごく盛り上がる予定です～

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: The general public can also participate, provided they are accompanied by participants of the Snake Festival. So as long as you are with Medusa here, there will be no problem.
text_block_list.orig_text:
蛇祭りの参加者と同伴という形で、
一般の方も参加可能です～
なので
メドゥーサさんとご一緒なら問題はありませんね～

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Hey, that's... under the assumption that I'm also going to this pre-party for the festival. No way, I'm not interested in some sloppy party with some idiots.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと、
それって
アタシが前夜祭に行く前提じゃない。
イヤよ、
雑なヤツらのどんちゃん騒ぎなんか
興味ないわよ。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Are you sure that's wise? Already, the fiercest warriors in Gio Gehenna have declared their participation, and they'll be entering the venue soon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいんですか～？　
もうすでにジオ・ゲヘナ中の猛者たちが
参加を表明してますよ～
もう少しで会場入りするとか。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: For example... "Her sweet scent is an invitation to death", the "Red Assassin" Boa Strawberry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
例えば
「甘い香りは死の招待状」
『赤き暗殺者』
ボア・ストロベリー！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Wow, that "Red Assassin" is... How interesting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へえ、
あの
『赤き暗殺者』が……
面白いじゃない。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: And then... "Listen! The Melody of Hell" - Garagara the Viper, the "Assassin of Mayhem"! ( TLNote: Garagara is the sound of rattling )
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして
「聴け！　
地獄のメロディ」
『騒乱の暗殺者』
ガラガラ・ザ・ヴァイパー！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me Garagara's also partecipating...! This is going to be rough...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさかガラガラまで……！　
これは大荒れになりそうね……

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Plus... "Everything in sight is my food" Cosmo Cobra, the "Gluttony Assassin"! I've compiled a list of all partecipants, so you can see who's expected in the lineup!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして
「視界に入るものすべて俺の糧」
『暴食の暗殺者』
コスモコブラ！
ざっと挙げただけでも
これだけの面子が揃ってますよ～

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: I knew it, so you're taking part too, Cosmo Cobra... That fellow... is the biggest obstacle to my victory!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やはり出場るのね、
コスモコブラ……
優勝への最大の障害となるのは
こいつね……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Y-You sure know a lot, Medusa. Also, isn't it me or there's too many "Assassins" in there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
く、
詳しいなメドゥーサ。
あと
暗殺者多すぎないか？

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Well, they're all snakes of sorts, after all. How about it, Medusa? It seems that those who are considered influential in the main tournament will go wild even during the pre-party for the festival...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
蛇ですから多少はね～
いかがですか
メドゥーサさん。
本戦で有力視されてる方は
前夜祭でも存分に暴れるみたいですよ～？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Hmph, I'm not the kind of good girl to just back down after hearing all of that. You guys, let's go to this pre-party already. We're going to show them who the star of the year is!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふん、
そこまで言われて引き下がるほど
いい子ちゃんじゃないわ。
アンタたち、
前夜祭行くわよ。
今年の主役が誰なのか、
ヤツらに思い知らせてやるんだから！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Somehow, again, I have a feeling something's bad about to happen...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだかまた
大変なことが起きそうね……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, Monika and the others were forced to take part in the pre-party for the festival, and headed to the Colosseum, where the celebration was being held.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして半ば強引に前夜祭に参加することになったモニカたちは、
会場であるコロッセオへと赴いた。

text_block_list.name: Snake Monsterfolk
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle...
text_block_list.orig_text: ザワザワザワ……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Wow, I know she called this a "pre-party", but it sure is lively already. And...they look all... pretty skilled! It wouldn't come as a surprise if any of those individuals won the tournament.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
前夜祭とはいえ
ずいぶんな賑わいだ。
それに……
皆、
かなりの手練ればかりだな……！
誰が優勝してもおかしくはないように見えるぞ。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't it obvious that I'm the winner? Whether it's the main event or the games of this pre-party, I'll win everything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと、
優勝はアタシに決まってるでしょ？
本番だろうが前夜祭だろうが、
全部勝ってやるわ！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: To everyone participating in the Snake Festival! Welcome to the Snake Festival pre-party! Have fun tonight, eating and drinking to your heart's content! ...As if, there's no one who really thinks that's all there is to it, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
蛇祭りにご参加のみなさ～ん！　
ようこそ蛇祭り前夜祭へ！
今宵は大いに飲んで食べて
楽しんでってくださ～い！
……
な～んて、
それだけで済むと思ってる人、
いませんよねぇ～！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Did you believe this was some kind of birthday party or something? Are you underestimating me? With those sly forked tongues of yours...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お誕生日パーティーじゃ
ないんですよ～？
なめてんですか？　
先っぽの割れた舌でチロチロチロと～

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: You all, what are you exactly? Serpents, snakes, serpents, exactly, you're all snakes here! Snakes are only good at eating, so they will eat the many trials that lie ahead, SHOW US YOUR SNAKE SPIRIT ALREADY!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたたちはなんですか？　
蛇
蛇
蛇
蛇、
そう蛇でしょ！
蛇は喰らってなんぼ、
これから行う数々の試練も喰らいつくし
テメエの蛇魂見せたらんか～い！

text_block_list.name: Snake Monsterfolk
text_block_list.text: HIIIISSSSSSSSSS!
text_block_list.orig_text: ウオオオオオオオオオオ！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was that girl always that kind of character? I thought she was just sucking up to Nephy Nella, what a shocking twist...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
アイツあんなキャラなの？
ネフィ＝ネラにくっついてるだけかと思ったけど、
意外ね……

text_block_list.name: Staff 2
text_block_list.text: No, that was just a performance for the audience. She's terrible at physical labor, but she's good at that kind of thing. Anyway, enjoy the party.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
ありゃあただのマイクパフォーマンスだ。
肉体労働はからっきしだけど、
ああいうのうまいんだぜ、
あいつ。
ま、
気軽に楽しんでってくれよ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Wait, even if you say that... There doesn't seem to be any opportunity for us to join in, plus I don't think there's much the three of us can do in those outfits, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
言われても……
あたしたちが混ざる隙なんてなさそうだし、
この格好でやれることなんて
ほとんどないわよ？

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's begin with the first trial! If you're a snake, you'll swallow it whole! The trial of greed, "Soul Eater"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ではさっそく、
最初の試練と参りましょう～！
蛇ならば丸ごと呑み込め！　
呑欲の試練
『ソウルイーター』！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Come on, already! You don't have to make it sound so dramatic! Furthermore what's with this trial's name?! What the hell are you going to make us do?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらもう！　
しょっぱなから物騒じゃない！
っていうか
試練ってなによ！　
一体なにをさせるつもりなのよ！？

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: For this trial, everyone will eating piping hot boiled eggs! Get into pairs and force a boiled egg into your partner's mouth!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みなさんには、
アツアツの煮卵を食べていただきます～！
二人一組になって、
相手の口に煮卵をねじ込んでくださ～い！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: That just sounds like a variety show! What did the "Soul Eater" part even have to do with it? Are you trying to make fun of m-... Ouch, ouch, what are you doing? Are you trying to kill me?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただのバラエティ企画じゃない！
なにがソウルイーターよ、
バカにして──
あっっつっ！
なにすんのよ殺す気か！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: No, that’s the rule here, isn’t it? Come on, open your mouth! Say "ahh" already! "Ahhh"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
そういうルールだろ？　
ほら、
口を開けろ！
あーんするんだ、
あーん！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Like I just said, that's impossible you moron, it's too hot! It's hot, you idiot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから無理だって、
あっつ！　
あっついわよバカー！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Come on, {0}, say "ahhh".
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら{0}、
あーんして。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Such tasks are best left to Kokkoro. Here you go, ahhh♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうのはコッコロにしてもらいなさい。
はい、
あーん♪

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Ughghgh, what a terrible experience... Surely you've got a proper trial lined up next...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ、
ひどい目に遭った……
次こそまともな試練なんでしょうね……

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: What's the next trial, you wonder? Bite off the spot you aimed for! The Biting Challenge: "Biting Point"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
続いての試練は～？
狙った場所を噛みちぎれ～！
咬絡の試練
『バイティングポイント』～！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Hmm, this one sounds just like a snake-like trial to me. I'll pay you back here for what you just did with the egg!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふーん、
今度は蛇らしい試練みたいね。
さっきの借りは
ここで返させてもらうわよ！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: ...Come on, let's keep going! Next up is... your right leg, red!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──さあ～
どんどんいきましょう！　
お次は……
右足、
赤～！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: AH! J-Just a little more... Kh, uu-! I-I've made it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あと少し……
く、
うぅー！　
と、
届いたぞ！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Hey, Monika! In the way... you're in my way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとモニカ！　
邪魔、
邪魔だってば！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: It can't be helped... those are the rules...! By the way, this game called "Biting Point", I believe we have our own version back in Landosol...! So this is what it's called in Gio Gehenna?
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕方ないだろ……
っそういうルール、
だ……！
ところでこの
『バイティングポイント』
というゲーム、
たしか
ランドソルにもあるな……！　
ジオ・ゲヘナではそう呼ぶのか。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: It likens using one's limbs to snakes and the bites to the designated color points. I-I see, the term "Biting Point" does make sense...
text_block_list.orig_text:
己の四肢を蛇に見立て、
指定された箇所に食らいつく。
な、
なるほど、
『バイティングポイント』とはよく言ったものだ……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: I don’t know anything of that! I mean what did you just say... how is this a game!
text_block_list.orig_text:
知らないわよ！　
ていうかもう
ゲームって言っちゃってるじゃない！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Next up... your left hand, blue!
text_block_list.orig_text:
続きまして～
左手、
青～！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: P-Please bear with it, I'm embarrassed too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
が、
我慢して、
あたしだって恥ずかしいのよ……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Ugh, even though I'm not mentally prepared at all, our faces are so close. I didn't expect to end up in such a situation while still wearing our formal clothes. This is tough...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ、
心の準備も全然できてないのに顔は近いわ、
晴れ着でこんな格好になるのも想定外すぎるわ、
大変だわ…………っ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Wait, no, no... Putting your face closer to there is... WHOAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
ヤ、
ヤダ……
そんなとこに顔近付けな、
あぁー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And so, the entertainment known as the "Trials" continued...
text_block_list.orig_text: こうして試練という名の余興は続いていった──

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. What's with this party? What's with those pre-party trials? We were just playing around! It's almost anticlimactic!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はぁ。
なにが前夜祭、
なにが試練よ。
ただ遊んだだけじゃない！
もう
拍子抜けもいいとこよ！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, but having fun together like this is a New Year's thing. Certainly, it was a bit unexpected... and very difficult in some parts...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
でも、
こうやってみんなでワイワイ遊ぶのも
正月らしくていいじゃない。
予想外にちょっと……
すごく
大変だったけど……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Umu! I'm glad you enjoyed yourself, my comrade! It's proof that my objective has been successfully achieved!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うむ！　
貴公が楽しかったのなら何よりだぞ！
順調に
我が目的が達成されているという証拠だなっ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, it's nothing. I'm just talking to myself. My comrade, all I want for you is to continue to enjoy this New Year's holiday in the days to come.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいや、
何でもない、
こちらの話だ。
貴公らには
引き続き、
順調に正月までの日々を過ごしてもらいたい。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Medusa too, it seems like her experience with the pre-party was fruitful in her own right, wasn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
メドゥーサも、
なかなか意義のある前夜祭になったようだしな？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
うっさいわね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: That's good to hear. Well then, we'll be heading back to Landosol, but good luck with the Snake Festival.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それならよかった。
じゃあ、
あたしたちは
ランドソルに戻るけど、
蛇祭り
頑張ってね。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: You don't have to tell me twice. Next time we meet, I'll be the champion. As a courtesy, I'll make sure to sign an autograph or two for you all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
言われなくても。
次会うときは
アタシはチャンピオンよ。
知り合いのよしみで
サインくらいは書いてあげるんだから。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Ever since my sisters left, I haven't had a meal or played loudly with anyone like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃんたちがいなくなってからこっち、
誰かとご飯食べたり、
大声出して
遊んだりなんてしてなかったわ。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: I know that this isn't exactly the time for me to be enjoying myself, but... I'm sure I'll find them. It's fine for me to have a little bit of fun, isn't it? Sisters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなことしてる場合じゃないのは分かってる。
でも……
きっと見つけ出すから。
今だけは
楽しくなっちゃっても
いいよね、
お姉ちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: While Monika and the others were having fun at the festival pre-party, a terrible scheme was unfolding outside the village.
text_block_list.orig_text:
モニカたちが前夜祭で盛り上がる中、
集落の外では恐ろしい企みが進行していた──

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Fweee fwee fwee *whistle sounds*
text_block_list.orig_text: ピーピーヒョロロピーヒョロロ～

text_block_list.text: Gurururururu...
text_block_list.orig_text: グルルルル……

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: I... I've really did it! The experiment was a huge success, and I'm sure I've achieved the correct result! I'm almost scared of my own talent!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった……
やりましたわ！
お実験は大成功、
あたくし様の勝ち確でございますわよ！
自分の才能がコワイくらいですわ！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: You stupid snakes, you should enjoy yourself while you can. The last laugh you'll have will be before me soon enough, and I'll make you all kneel together! OH HO HO HO♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
おマヌケな蛇さんたち、
せいぜい今のうちに楽しんでおくことですわ。
最後に笑うのはこのあたくし、
みんなまとめて跪かせてやりますわ！
ヲ～
ッホッホッホ♪
